'''2001 Australasian Continental Championship''' (the "Calamari Continental Championships") was the 2001 Star Wars CCG Continental Championship for Australia, a two-day event with a cut to Day 2, played before 8 August 2001. Adam Amy won it.<ref name="dt-18166">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18166 SYCFA Has a Flipside], DeckTech (John "Aeon" Lampe, 8 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18166/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18166/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 8 August)
* '''Site:''' Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Winner:''' Adam Amy

Decipher's 2001 list of World Championship qualifiers gave only "Australia (no title yet)", with dates to be announced.<ref name="dec-oq">[https://starshipexcelsior.com/othersites/stccg1e/rules_archive/decipher/Z_KLAUSERS_ARCHIVE/Worlds2001.htm A Players' Guide to the World Championship Open Qualifiers], Decipher (2001). Copy on Starship Excelsior.</ref> The date, city and venue are not given in the posts below. Players came from Sydney and Melbourne.<ref name="dt-18214">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18214 HuntDown  Australian Conties Hero], DeckTech (chris "Austin316" morris, 10 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18214/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18214/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

Luca Costanzo went 6–0 across both days with his Light list.<ref name="dt-18145" /> Chris Morris went 5–1 with his Dark list and finished 12th overall; his one loss was to a Watch Your Step deck in the last game of Day 2.<ref name="dt-18214" /> John Lampe's Dark list was disqualified on Day 1 because Weapon Levitation and Projective Telepathy were left off his decklist, then let into Day 2; he called Adam Amy "the Calamari Continental Champion".<ref name="dt-18166" />
